# canonical: x = argmin ||A x - b||_2 for A m x n, m >= n, full column rank: x = (A^T A)^-1 A^T b, exact rational.
# refusals (16.LA.4 format): 'ERR Singular rank_deficient' if rank A < n; 'ERR DimensionMismatch wide' if m < n; 'ERR DimensionMismatch b_len' if len(b) != m (checked before n = 0). n = 0 (m x 0 or 0 x 0): Ok, x empty.

# enclosure: x[n] as lo hi pairs at b = 256, grid 2^e with e = floor(log2|x|) - b + 1 (enclose_rational); re-checked against mpmath (1200 bits, normal equations); python-flint arb hook pending (Harper).
# columns (gate): case_id dims(mxn) blen A[m*n] b[blen] (x[n] x_lohi256[2*n] cond_row k_row scale_row containment_only reason rref | ERR variant detail); m x 0 rows have no x, lohi or cond fields
# format: 2 (format 1 had no cond columns; readers accept both, keyed on this line)
# cond columns: after the value columns of a non-refusal row, in this order: cond_row k_row scale_row containment_only reason rref (refusal rows have none)
# cond_row: exact rational p/q = || |A^-1| P^T|L||U| ||_inf (componentwise Skeel condition with growth from the exact L, U of la_lu's pivoting)
# k_row: decimal integer = 4 + ceil(log2 n) + ceil(log2 cond_row), exact
# scale_row: exact rational p/q; 1/1 for ln outputs (logdet), ||x||_inf for solve
# containment_only reason: closed set 0 tight | 1 k_row_too_large | 2 lstsq_x_zero (k_row_too_large: k_row + 8 >= 192: no replay prec in {53, 113, 192} has prec > k_row + 8; lstsq_x_zero: lstsq x = 0, scale_row undefined). The code does not depend on prec: 1 or 2 means containment only at EVERY replay prec; 0 does not mean tight at every prec, the replay still applies prec > k_row + 8 per prec
# rref: exact rational p/q, diagnostic only (never a gate): c with first-order bound c*2^-prec from |dA| <= gamma_n P^T|L||U|, gamma_n ~ n*2^-prec; logdet c = n*tr(|A^-1| P^T|L||U|), solve c = n*|| |A^-1| P^T|L||U| |x| ||_inf
# tightness (replay): rad <= 2^(k_row - prec) * max(|v|, scale_row) when prec > k_row + 8, containment only otherwise
# lstsq cond (16.LA.5): with A m x n full column rank, A^+ = (A^T A)^-1 A^T, x = A^+ b, r = b - A x (all exact):
#   cond_row = ( || |A^+||A| ||_inf * ||x||_inf + || |(A^T A)^-1| |A^T| |r| ||_inf ) / ||x||_inf  (exact-fit r = 0: first term only; residual term not capped)
#   k_row = 4 + ceil(log2 m) + ceil(log2 cond_row) (m = row count); scale_row = ||x||_inf
#   rref (diagnostic, never a gate) = m * || |A^+||A||x| + |(A^T A)^-1||A^T||r| ||_inf
#   x = 0 (lstsq_x_zero, in the closed reason set above): cond_row and k_row from the first term || |A^+||A| ||_inf only
